reasoning_traces.think:
The core innovation lies in transforming discrete football actions into dense, semantically meaningful embeddings using Graph Neural Networks. This enables a shift from rigid, predefined phase definitions to a flexible, customizable classification system. The embedding process encodes spatial relationships among players and contextual features of the pass (e.g., location, body part), forming a continuous vector space where similar tactical situations cluster together. By leveraging this embedding space, the system supports a modular approach to phase identification—where experts define their own phase boundaries rather than relying on fixed rules. This dualism between structure (GNN embeddings) and semantics (expert labeling) creates a robust foundation for tactical analysis. Failure modes include overfitting to idiosyncratic labeling or insufficient data to distinguish phase boundaries. The framework also supports retroactive analysis and real-time adaptation, making it suitable for both post-game review and live tactical adjustments.
